about: End-to-end prompts for agent runs of the skill (skill-creator format). Run them with the Apify connector, a signed-in browser, or both, as each prompt says; grade with the assertions. The deterministic back-test lives in vet_cases.json and ats_years_cases.json (run_evals.py).

evals.expected_output: Asks once whether to apply or only search (a bare slash command authorizes nothing), then searches LinkedIn, Indeed and Dice for the chosen window (through Apify when the session has it), vets with vet.py, applies only after the answer, writes rows to the tracker database and reports.
assertions: Asks a single AskUserQuestion covering apply-vs-search before any submission
Loads all Chrome tools in one ToolSearch call
Runs the bundled scripts from the skill folder
Reads the tracker's jobs collection and skips links already present
Runs vet.py in card mode before opening job pages
Every submitted application has 'Application sent' or an equivalent confirmation in the transcript
Overwrites prefilled years with the profile's verified_years values
Writes new rows with ArtifactData batch rather than republishing the tracker page
Records a runs/<date> document listing portals not searched
Final report names the applications, the Review items and what was not searched
Writes tracker rows after each portal and right after each application, not only at the end
Every row written, hand-built ones included, passed tracker.py check (no category outside the list)
Sets meta/criteria from tracker.py criteria once in the run
No javascript_tool result in the transcript is cut off with [TRUNCATED] for a snippet the skill ships

evals.prompt: apply to java jobs posted today, remote or chicago, and also do the company site ones I queued on the tracker
evals.expected_output: Uses a 24-hour window, applies to High/Medium Easy Apply jobs, then handles Queued company-site jobs: asks for domain access once, applies only on guest-form ATSs, and leaves account-walled ones in Review.
assertions: Uses f_TPR=r86400 (24 hours) on LinkedIn and fromage=1 on Indeed
Queries jobs where status == Queued before searching
Runs ats.py on each Queued apply URL
Asks for domain access for all company-site hosts in one message
Runs form_scan.js before filling any company-site form
Does not create an account or type a password on any site
Sets appliedBy to 'claude' on company-site jobs it submitted
Leaves Workday, iCIMS or Taleo jobs in Review with 'account required'

evals.prompt: can you just search and tell me what's out there this week, don't apply to anything
evals.expected_output: Search and vet only: a 7-day window (or the profile window with a note), tracker rows written as New or Review, no submissions.
assertions: No application is submitted
New qualifying rows are written with status New, not Applied
Report lists the High and Medium jobs with links

evals.prompt: The job in Needs you that wants entertainment-industry experience: Apply anyway, I'm fine with answering 0.
evals.expected_output: Applies to the Review row, answers the entertainment question with 0 and every other question from the profile, and updates the row to Applied.
assertions: Answers the entertainment-industry question with 0
Updates that job's tracker row to Applied with if_version from a fresh read
Does not change any other row

evals.prompt: apply to the good fits. Also apply the Uline posting
evals.expected_output: Applies to Queued rows first (an Easy Apply needs-call row the user queued included), asks once for any screening answer the profile lacks and asks again if the reply carries no value, then follows Uline's Apply link to its final host, finds Workday, and leaves it with the user with an updated Review row instead of creating an account.
assertions: Applies to the Queued Easy Apply row before searching
Asks for a missing screening figure (for example production-support years) instead of guessing, and re-asks when the answer has no number
Clicks through the careers page and classifies the final application host (myworkdayjobs.com) as Workday
Does not create an account or type a password even when the user asks; offers an answer sheet instead
Sets ats Workday, claudeCanApply false and applyUrl on the Uline row

evals.prompt: search linkedin posts for JAVA AND CONTRACT/W2 from today and add the good ones to my tracker
evals.expected_output: Runs a 24-hour LinkedIn post search with the user's keywords, parses and vets posts with posts.py, writes passing ones as Reach out rows with contact details, and contacts nobody.
assertions: Runs plan.py with --post-query carrying the user's keywords and --hours 24
Runs linkedin_posts.js on the content-search page and pages through it
Runs posts.py before writing any row
New rows have status Review and reviewReason contact
Rows carry contactEmail or contactPhone when the post showed one
No email, message or connection request is sent

evals.prompt: search and save java jobs from the last 24 hours (session: Apify connector, no browser tools)
evals.expected_output: Runs without a browser: says nothing will be submitted, builds the plan with --apify, runs one Actor call per portal with the plan's caps, converts and vets the rows without opening a page, writes rows with descriptions to the tracker, marks recruiter posts and the on-site LinkedIn and Dice searches as not searched, and reports the jobs with tracker.py table and the Apify cost.
assertions: Does not ask whether to apply (the request says search and save) and does not offer Apply
Runs plan.py with --apify and --seen, and tracker.py run start with --apify and --no-browser
Every call-actor uses an actor, input and callOptions (maxTotalChargeUsd) taken from the plan
get-dataset-items is called with the plan's fields list
Runs apify_jobs.py convert, then vet.py --mode full, before writing any row
No browser tool is called and no job page is opened
New rows have status Review with reviewReason ready, and carry desc, postedAt and via apify
Report includes the tracker.py table output, what was not searched and the Apify cost estimate
No Apify token appears in the transcript, the run log or a row

evals.prompt: run my job search and apply to the good fits (session: Apify connector and Claude in Chrome)
evals.expected_output: Searches through Apify, uses the browser only for the searches the plan leaves to it, recruiter posts and applications; before each application opens the job's link and confirms the title and company match the Apify row.
assertions: Preflight probes only portals the browser will touch
Jobs found through Apify are vetted without opening their pages
Each application starts by opening the row's link and checking title and company
Applied is set only after a confirmation screen
A portal whose Actor call failed is searched in the browser and its run step is marked --via browser

evals.prompt: run my job search (session: Apify connector and a browser; Dice returns 403 in the browser, the Indeed Actor call fails with a usage-limit error)
evals.expected_output: Indeed falls back to the browser (the planned fallback). The Dice 403 in the browser is not worked around: Claude asks the user once to open the page, retries once, then skips Dice with the reason and the search links.
assertions: After the usage-limit error no further Apify call is retried in a loop
Indeed's searches run in the browser and the run log says so
After the Dice 403 no other browser, mirror, cache, direct request or Apify call is used for that Dice search
The user is asked once to open the Dice page and reply done; one retry follows
A skipped portal appears under Not searched with its reason
